title: Hearing on plans for expiring Emergency Housing Vouchers
summary: The Council's Public Housing Committee examined how NYCHA and HPD are preparing for the end of the federal Emergency Housing Voucher program, which is expected to run out of funding by the end of 2026. NYCHA administers about 5,000 vouchers and HPD about 1,700, and both agencies are directing recipients toward alternatives like public housing applications or the HOME Tenant-Based Rental Assistance program. The committee also heard Resolution 495, which calls on the state legislature and governor to pass a bill expanding priority and simplifying inspections under New York's new Housing Access Voucher Program.
